title: rustyprint render options
description: Options for rendering one HTML document to PDF. Every field is optional; a field left out keeps its default. Lengths are CSS lengths in px, mm, cm, in or pt; a number without a unit is in px.

page_size.description: The page size, by name or as a width and height. Default: A4.

oneOf.description: A3, A4, A5, Letter or Legal, in any case.

landscape.description: Turns the page so that it is wider than it is tall. Default: false.

margin.description: Page margins like the CSS margin shorthand: one to four non-negative lengths for the top, right, bottom and left. Default: 2cm.

title.description: The PDF document title. Overrides the document's <title>.

stylesheet.description: A stylesheet applied after the document's own styles.

remote.description: Hosts that absolute URLs may be fetched from. Without it, nothing is fetched from the network.

allowed_hosts.description: Host names, such as cdn.example.com, or *.example.com for its subdomains. Redirects must stay on them.

allow_http.description: Also fetch plain http URLs. Default: false.

timeout_ms.description: How long one fetch may take. Default: 10000.

max_bytes.description: The largest file fetched. Default: 10485760 (10 MB).

max_fetches.description: Files fetched per render; the rest are not loaded. Default: 100.

limits.description: Bounds on the work of the render. Exceeding one fails the render, except that larger images are skipped with a warning.

max_input_bytes.description: Size of the HTML in bytes. Default: 20971520 (20 MB).

max_nodes.description: DOM nodes, including text and comments, across the document and its iframe documents. Default: 500000.

max_depth.description: How deeply elements nest; 1 for the root element alone. Default: 512.

max_image_pixels.description: Width times height of an image; larger images are skipped with a warning. Default: 100000000.

timeout_ms.description: How long the render may take, or null for no deadline. Default: 60000.

length.description: A CSS length in px, mm, cm, in or pt, such as 15mm; a number without a unit is in px.
